version: v1.5.2 — FPS Boost + Turbo F2/F10 + Fast World Gen
name: Geoplanetical Fire Performance Mod
description:
Made this mod for my laptop (8GB RAM / integrated graphics) to get smooth 60 FPS and make Speed 3 actually fast, but works great on all PCs!

WHAT IT DOES:
- FPS Boost (removes heavy textures, 3D clouds/atmosphere, and UI blurs)
- Turbo Speed 3 (>>> runs at ~16 days/sec with smooth daily date counter)
- Fast World Gen (~80s faster New Game load, skips redundant prewarm)
- Month-End UI Browsing (browse tabs during ticks without freezing)
- Hotkeys: F10 toggles Fire Graphics, F2 toggles Turbo Speed 3 (F11 untouched)

EASY 1-CLICK INSTALL:
Steam Workshop only loads textures by default. Run installer once:
1. In Steam, right-click Geoplanetical > Manage > Browse local files.
2. In address bar click 'steamapps', then go to: workshop/content/3182430/3834097787
3. Double-click Install-Mod.bat and wait until Done (or get zip on GitHub!)
4. Launch the game! You will see 'FIRE [F10] · TURBO [F2]' and FPS in top-right corner.

HOW TO TOGGLE OR UNINSTALL:
- F10: toggle Fire Graphics ON/OFF with on-screen toast.
- F2: toggle Turbo Speed 3 ON/OFF.
- Or turn off in Mods menu, or run Uninstall-Mod.bat to restore.
